scope: Selected visual observations from original JPEGs, not an exhaustive inventory or a decipherment. Rectangles use x, y, width, height in original pixels and may include whitespace.

notes.title: Cross-like drawings in opposite margins
notes.text: Two dark drawings flank the text: one high in the right margin and one lower in the left. Each has a long upright stem crossed by three bars. The broadest bar is toward the top of the right-hand drawing and toward the bottom of the left-hand drawing. This describes their visible arrangement; it does not establish an exact rotation or a decoding instruction.

notes.text: A small two-lobed loop sits above the first text row, and another below the final row. They are separate from the large cross-like margin drawings. Their resemblance to an infinity sign is a visual description, not an established mathematical instruction.
